meta.name: News + IPO Scanner
meta.notes: Flag price = market price at scan time on flag date. Shares are fractional. P/L is hypothetical; no fees/slippage modeled. Measurement instrument, not a live strategy.
meta.score_rubric: catalyst/30 momentum/25 liquidity/15 risk/15(higher=safer) valuation/15; set at flag time
meta.exit_rules: auto-close if price <= flag*(1+stop_pct/100); review_date forces thesis re-check
meta.direction_rule: vol24 calls evaluated at eval_date: hit if sign(move since flag) matches call; feature killed if <=50% after 30 calls
meta.options_rules: Options book. UP TO 8 CONTRACTS/DAY across four feeders: SPY 1DTE (exactly 1), ETF universe, blue-chip universe, catalyst movers/earnings. GATES UNCHANGED: 2-10% OTM (0.2-1.5% for 1DTE), OI>=500, spread<=20% of ask, contracts_n = floor(250/(ask*100)), cost<=$250, BUY at ask, mark/exit at bid. Separate pool from the $1,000 stock portfolio. Target = 6x entry ask, stop = 0.5x entry ask (10:1, set by Andres 2026-08-12 over advisory objection). Exit at first of: target, stop, 2 trading days, expiry. Confidence score frozen at entry; bands A>=75, B 60-74, C 45-59, D<45; the score RANKS, it does not gate. KILL RULE 1 (book): closes if total P/L < 0 after 20 resolved positions. KILL RULE 2 (score): after 20 resolved scored contracts, if mean P/L%% of A+B does not exceed C+D, option_score.py is deleted from the pipeline. Prior study: median -100%% per trade.

portfolio.weighting: score-weighted within book at rebase; new flags sized by score band from book cash; exits return cash to book

spy_model.rule: Composite 0-100 from five fixed components: trend/30, momentum/25, volatility/20, breadth/15, news/10. >=60 BULLISH, <=40 BEARISH, else NEUTRAL. Weights FROZEN 2026-08-13.
spy_model.grading: Every scan publishes a next-session direction call BEFORE the session. Graded on SPY close-to-close. NEUTRAL calls recorded but not graded.
spy_model.kill: If direction hit rate < 55% after 30 graded calls, stop the 1DTE book and record the finding.

dte1_rules.strike: exactly ONE strike per day, nearest to the band midpoint that passes all gates
dte1_rules.direction: taken from the SPY composite bias; NEUTRAL days trade nothing
dte1_rules.gates: OI >= 500, spread <= 20% of ask, contracts = floor(250/(ask*100)), total cost <= $250, expiry = next session
dte1_rules.exits: target 6x ask / stop 0.5x ask (10:1) or expiry
dte1_rules.prior: The 811-day study found 0-2DTE SPY OTM has median -100% per trade. Same 20-position kill rule.

notes.13F (institutions >$100M): 45 days after quarter end — Feb 14, May 15, Aug 14, Nov 14. Positions are up to 4.5 months stale; treat as sentiment, never as a trade signal.
notes.Form 4 (insiders): within 2 business days of the trade — the most timely legal disclosure. Filing burst typically 4:00-6:30pm ET.
notes.SC 13D (activist >5%): within 10 days of crossing 5% — the highest-signal filing; often moves the stock on the filing itself.
notes.Block/dark prints: cluster in the opening 30 min (9:30-10:00 ET) and the closing auction (3:50-4:00 ET). Free feeds do not expose these reliably.
notes.Options sweeps: cluster first hour and last hour; requires paid flow data.

confidence_score.components: execution/25 (spread 15 + OI 10) · breakeven/25 · signal/25 · clock/15 · iv_cost/10
confidence_score.note: The breakeven component has the most prior support: a ratio above 1.0 means paying for a larger move than the chain itself implies.

positions.name: SpaceX
positions.thesis: Largest IPO in history ($1.75T valuation, $85.7B raised) digesting below its $161 day-one close. Starlink growth and defense contracts are the catalyst stream; post-IPO lockup supply is the risk.

positions.name: SK hynix (US listing)
positions.thesis: HBM memory is the supply bottleneck of the AI buildout. Fresh US listing at $149; trades roughly flat vs offer while AI capex headlines keep coming. TSM strength corroborates the chip-cycle signal.

positions.name: Apnimed
positions.thesis: Best performer of the 2026 IPO cohort (+~55% vs offer). First oral drug candidate for obstructive sleep apnea — huge untreated market. Biotech leadership is the strongest sector signal in this year’s IPO tape.

positions.name: Scribe Therapeutics
positions.thesis: CRISPR-by-design platform, +~55% vs offer in three weeks. Rides the same 2026 biotech-IPO strength as Apnimed; higher science risk, earlier pipeline.

positions.name: Ionic Digital
positions.thesis: Crypto-mining/infrastructure listing up ~12% vs offer. Crypto stocks led Monday’s movers, but options markets are positioned for an August BTC pullback — this position tests whether equity flow beats that caution.

positions.name: Standard Nuclear
positions.thesis: Busted IPO (-45% at the July low) that has bounced ~47% off the bottom. The AI-datacenter power crunch keeps nuclear in the news cycle. Highest-risk flag on the board — this tests the busted-IPO-rebound pattern.

positions.name: CoreWeave
positions.thesis: The 2025 IPO that worked: AI GPU cloud with a ~$99B backlog and OpenAI/Meta contracts. Tests whether IPO winners keep winning once seasoned.

positions.name: Circle Internet Group
positions.thesis: USDC issuer earning Treasury yield on reserves. Stablecoin regulation and crypto-payments adoption are recurring world-news catalysts; rate cuts are the main headwind to its interest income.

positions.name: Kosmos Energy
positions.thesis: Jumped 13% Monday as the Venezuela blockade aftermath tightens heavy-crude supply. Small-cap offshore producer = high beta to any further supply disruption. Pure world-news flag.

positions.name: Taiwan Semiconductor
positions.thesis: Moved on Monday’s tape as AI capex headlines continue. The world’s chip chokepoint: benefits from every AI announcement, carries every Taiwan-strait headline as tail risk. The control-adjacent large-cap on the board.

positions.name: Hertz Global
positions.thesis: Q2 revenue beat (Aug 7) plus 587k-contract options frenzy and retail momentum. Speculative squeeze mechanics, not fundamentals — treated as such.

positions.name: Plug Power
positions.thesis: Most-active tape (145M shares) at $2.22 after restructuring; down 92% over 5 years. Pure turnaround lottery ticket — flagged to test whether penny momentum means anything.

positions.name: Geron
positions.thesis: Approved drug (Rytelo) with real revenue at a $1B cap; +10% day amid biotech strength. The least lottery-like of the penny book.

positions.name: Rocket Lab
positions.thesis: Founder-led (Beck); only credible SpaceX alternative at small/medium launch plus vertically-integrated space systems; Neutron is the 5x catalyst. Criteria: founder-led ✓, category ✓, TAM ✓.

positions.name: AST SpaceMobile
positions.thesis: Satellite-to-ordinary-phone broadband; carrier deals (AT&T/Verizon/Vodafone) validate. Binary outcome: constellation economics work or they do not. The most Tesla-2013-shaped risk profile on the board.

positions.name: Oklo
positions.thesis: Small modular reactors aimed at AI datacenter power; Altman-linked; pre-revenue so this is optionality on the power crunch becoming policy. Highest risk of the long-term book.

positions.name: Tempus AI
positions.thesis: Founder-led (Lefkofsky); proprietary clinical+molecular data moat feeding AI diagnostics; the pick-and-shovel of AI medicine. Criteria: founder-led ✓, data moat ✓, real revenue ✓.
